nominal_estimator.model_source: completion_runs/00/baseline/gpd_poly_symbolic_v5/vendor/gpd_lo_baseline_v4/src/models.py:ReferenceNetwork('film'); use source unchanged in a later task-scoped fitter
nominal_estimator.model_dtype: torch.float64 on CPU; width 24, two conditioned residual blocks, channels [Sigma,T,Hg], parity and (1-x^2)^2 endpoint envelope, no Q2 input or fitted-checkpoint warm start
nominal_estimator.moment_source: completion_runs/00/baseline/gpd_poly_symbolic_v5/src/polynomiality.py:MomentProjector; pass deterministic scales and new nodes from completion_runs/01/review_helpers.py without modifying the baseline

moment_constraint.all_allowed_powers: For each channel and N, V_N=span{(xi/0.6)^(2k): k=0,...,N/2}; all coefficients free, none fixed or symbolically pruned.

diagnostic_nodes.formula: xi_i=0.02+0.96*(i+0.5)/80, i=0,...,79; strictly disjoint from fit nodes

fixed_numerical_scales.meaning: Integrals of unit-amplitude shapes x(1-x^2)^2 and (1-x^2)^2; numerical penalty scales, not moments inferred from truths/observations or fixed GPD coefficients. Identical across starts, datasets and profiles.

moment_constraint.domain_meaning: Reference-scale moment-integration nodes only, not new CFF measurements and requiring no new perturbative banks; finite-spin/collocation checks do not prove global polynomiality. Broad-domain difficulty requires review, never silent narrowing.

objective.residual_order: fit_xi order outer, fit_Q2 order inner, [ReH,ImH] order within each point; r=prediction-observation
objective.L_poly: (1/(3*4*41))*sum over channel c, spin N and fit node i of [(M_cN(xi_i)-(Q_N Q_N^T M_cN)_i)/s_cN]^2; Q_N from QR of the entire allowed-power design on all 41 fit nodes; N quark moment x^(N-1), gluon moment x^(N-2), using 48 quadrature nodes per side
objective.covariance: Use the frozen block-diagonal synthetic Re/Im covariance from noise.rule; any PSD rank-deficient case obeys data_contract.json nullspace support checks, not arbitrary residual deletion.
objective.no_extra_rescaling: No extra division of L_poly by n_scalar, no adaptive scales, no start-specific normalization, no additional prior/penalty or truth-dependent selection. This is a prospective regularization change and is not asserted equal to the v5 loss.
objective.same_everywhere: This exact J, scales, covariance, numerical integration and model apply to every random start, unrestricted refit, constrained profile, calibration and test replicate.

optimizer.start_seed_rule: Two independent initializations with labels 31 and 43; seed = first 63 bits of SHA256('20260923|'+phase+'|'+opaque_outer_index+'|'+start_label). Truth identity and final-test outcomes are not seed inputs; noise streams remain separate.
optimizer.convergence: Run all 400 Adam steps, then L-BFGS. Accept a start only with finite J/gradients and either documented L-BFGS tolerance termination or final Euclidean gradient norm <=1e-6. Reaching caps without this evidence is a failure, not a converged solution.
optimizer.selection_and_tie: Choose smaller converged unrestricted J. If absolute J difference <=1e-10*max(1,abs(J_best)), choose start label 31. If neither converges, record failed fit and use conservative full-line interval only for coverage accounting; report failure separately.
optimizer.no_tuning: These are prospective v4-derived settings, not benchmarked on the new truths. Any later adjustment needs review before calibration/test.

nominal_estimator.candidate_selection: Nominal candidate is the all-allowed model only. Any future architecture/penalty/symbolic selection is exploratory unless its entire selection procedure is included inside every calibration and test replicate.
nominal_estimator.acceptance_diagnostics: Record optimizer convergence, finite gradients, max normalized training CFF residual, fit-spin normalized moment RMS <=1e-3, 80 disjoint xi-node diagnostics, held-out spins 10,12 and 96-versus-48 integration refinement. A failed diagnostic is reported, never silently repaired by loosening thresholds.

development_exclusion: All v4/v5 smooth, skewed, dterm, oscillatory, endpoint_stress and dd_mixture truths and their train/holdout grids, fits, thresholds and figures are development evidence. They are not independent final calibration/test data.

frozen_final_truths.basis_definition: D_odd(j,b)=vendor/gpd_lo_baseline_v4/src/truths.py:dd_profile(x,xi,j,b,parity='odd',order=80); D_even similarly parity='even'. z=x/xi; qD=1_(|z|<1)*z*(1-z^2)^2; gD=1_(|z|<1)*xi*(1-z^2)^2. Evaluate at Q0^2; evolve with the final validated NLO forward model.
frozen_final_truths.qualification: These are mathematical synthetic GPD truth definitions, not proven positive physical proton GPDs; b=3 and b=0.5 are outside the v4 DD comparator profiles b=1,2. No final truth has yet been numerically generated or fitted.

kinematic_split.fit_points: full Cartesian product, 15 complex CFF points per dataset
kinematic_split.selection_points: full Cartesian product, nine complex CFF points reserved for predictive diagnostic only; not used to choose nominal estimator
kinematic_split.development_disjoint: The exact xi and Q2 coordinates are disjoint from the v4/v5 development train and holdout lists.

noise.rule: At each kinematic point let r=ReH_true, i=ImH_true, sigma_R=0.04*max(1,abs(r)), sigma_I=0.04*max(1,abs(i)); draw centered bivariate normal with correlation rho=0.25 between Re and Im. Different kinematic points and outer datasets are independent. The covariance is known to the synthetic fitter; no inferred dense-grid pseudo-observations.
noise.randomness: Counter-based or independently seeded PRNG streams keyed by (truth ID, phase, outer index, geometry). Master seed 20260923. No seed reuse across smoke/calibration/test or fit initialization.
noise.generator: Use a separately refined and externally validated NLO forward route after stages 02-03; do not generate final arrays before approval.

uncertainty_method.interval: For estimand j use the set of f with Delta_j(f)<=c_j, where Delta_j(f)=min_{theta:F_j(theta)=f}J(theta;y)-min_theta J(theta;y). Profile the identical frozen penalized objective over all other parameters. Report detected disconnected components as a union, not a falsely connected band; an analytically certified unbounded side remains unbounded. This is a simulation-calibrated profile-objective difference, not a Wilks claim. No Hessian pseudoinverse may manufacture finite width.

profile_algorithm.statistic: Delta_j(f)=J_constrained_min(f)-J_unrestricted_min with J and fixed scales exactly as nominal_estimator.objective; both minima use the same training data, model and covariance.
profile_algorithm.equality_solver: SciPy SLSQP with Torch float64 autodiff objective/Jacobian and equality F_j(theta)-f=0; maxiter=500, ftol=1e-10; accept only solver success, finite J/gradient and |F_j(theta)-f|<=1e-6*max(1,|f|). No relaxed inequality surrogate.
profile_algorithm.starts: For each f, initialize constrained optimization from both converged unrestricted starts and, when available, the nearest already-converged constrained solution on the same profile side. At most three constrained starts; retain the smallest feasible J. Warm starts change initialization only, never J or scales. Failed starts are logged, not silently dropped.
profile_algorithm.unrestricted_inconsistency: If any feasible constrained J is below the recorded unrestricted J by any amount, run up to two further unrestricted L-BFGS restarts initialized at that constrained solution, using the frozen J and L-BFGS settings. Replace unrestricted J only with an improved converged value. If Delta remains negative, record optimizer inconsistency/failure and a +infinity conservative calibration statistic or full-line test interval with failure flag; never max(0,Delta) or omit the record.
profile_algorithm.bracketing: From unrestricted f_hat, probe both directions at step 0.05*max(1,|f_hat|), doubling up to 20 probes per direction and |f|<=1000. At each probed f use the fixed constrained solver; detect threshold crossings and possible re-entry/disconnected accepted components. Stop on solver failure rather than treating it as rejection.
profile_algorithm.refinement: Bisection each detected crossing for at most 40 iterations or until f-width<=1e-5*max(1,|f_hat|), with the same constrained solver and equality tolerance. Report the union of detected accepted components and its outer hull/width as separate fields.
profile_algorithm.search_cap_or_unbounded: A 20-probe, |f|=1000 or 40-bisection cap without resolved endpoint is search_cap_limited, not proof of mathematical infinity; count as failed inversion and assign full-real-line interval for conservative coverage accounting. Mark a profile side mathematically unbounded only with a separately recorded constructive/analytic certificate. An infinite calibrated cutoff produces a full-line interval flagged calibration_infinite, not a claim that the profile itself was proven unbounded.

calibration_rule.per_truth_diagnostic: For each estimand j and calibration truth h in {A,B}, require all 80 nonnegative profile statistics at the known F_j(truth_h). Ordinarily q_hj is the 73rd order statistic (ceil(0.90*(80+1))); conservatively set q_hj=+infinity if any of its 80 values is +infinity, even when its ordinary 73rd value is finite. Retain q_Aj and q_Bj only as oracle diagnostics.
calibration_rule.applied_common_cutoff: c_j=max(q_Aj,q_Bj), one cutoff keyed only by estimand ID. Apply exactly the same c_j to every test dataset in both truth classes without reading its truth label; no final-test result changes c_j. Implementation helper: review_helpers.freeze_common_cutoffs.
calibration_rule.invalid_and_infinite: All 80 statistics per truth/estimand are mandatory. NaN or negative values invalidate calibration and must not be deleted; a solver failure is explicitly flagged and represented conservatively by +infinity, which forces the affected common c_j to infinity under the supplied helper. Do not hide failure as a certified unbounded profile.

stored_cutoff_binding.hash: SHA-256 of canonical sorted-key serialized configuration and source digests
stored_cutoff_binding.use: Reject cutoff reuse on any mismatch; do not transfer a complex-CFF synthetic cutoff to ReH-only experimental data.

calibration_rule.scope: Calibration over two selected benchmark truths is not a uniform guarantee over all admissible GPDs. ReH-only experimental data require a separately reviewed uncertainty/calibration contract.

uncertainty_method.critical_value: One common c_j per estimand is max of the two truth-specific 73rd-of-80 calibration values, with a conservative +infinity override if any constituent statistic is +infinity. Apply the same c_j to all 240-per-truth test datasets; truth-specific values are oracle diagnostics only. Invalid statistics abort, and test truth labels never select a cutoff.
uncertainty_method.coverage: Marginal 90% intervals are evaluated separately for both estimands and each truth. Report exact count/240, Wilson 95% interval, median and 90th-percentile finite width, unbounded fraction and failure fraction. Claim adequate coverage only if the one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound is >=0.85 in all four truth-by-estimand cells; no optional stopping or pooled-only pass.
uncertainty_method.failure_handling: Solver/profile nonconvergence, invalid covariance, negative/NaN unrepairable statistic, search-cap exhaustion, failed refinement or unmet physical/numerical diagnostics are explicit failures. Assign full-real-line interval to a failed test inversion for conservative coverage accounting, and separately report failed-fit/profile fraction, successfully certified unbounded-profile fraction, calibration-infinite-cutoff fraction and finite-width distribution. Infinite intervals alone do not establish useful target resolution. If failure fraction exceeds 5% in any cell, overall method fails regardless of coverage. No deletion or favorable-subset selection.

mandatory_controls: Three-spin control: rerun a development-only nominal diagnostic with N=2,4,6 enforced and N=8 held out, then compare with four-spin fit; do not use to tune final cutoff after test outcomes.

D-term control: in truth_A isolate the explicit qD/gD contribution and verify that evolution/convolution includes it once; compare zero-D synthetic counterfactual as a labeled control, not a competing final truth.

Shadow control: construct a normalized training-bank weak right-singular direction using training geometry only, perturb a development truth, and report CFF shift versus both primary-estimand shifts; do not inspect final test noise to choose the direction.

counts.pilot: 2 truths x 1 deterministic seed each, no inference claim
counts.smoke_outer_datasets: 20 total, 10 per truth; discarded from calibration/test
